# AUB HANDOFF Analysis

## Champion Assessment
| Metric | Value | Status |
|--------|-------|--------|
| OOS Mean | 1.8815 | ✅ Strong |
| OOS Min | 0.4315 | ⚠️ Weak fold |
| Exposure | 0.47–0.84 | ✅ Acceptable |
| Degenerate | 0 | ✅ Clean |

**Diagnosis**: High mean but low min indicates overfitting to some folds. Priority: improve worst-fold robustness.

## Next Commands
```
mutate --target=min_fold --regularization=+0.1 --priority=robustness
explore --reduce-features --min-importance=0.02 --folds=worst
validate --oos-threshold=0.7 --ensemble=3
```
